LSI Industries President and CEO Jim Clark has been recognized as CEO of the Year at the Cincinnati Business Courier's C-Suite Awards.
Jim Clark, the President and CEO of LSI Industries, was honored as CEO of the Year at the Cincinnati Business Courier C-Suite Awards. The award recognizes his leadership and contributions to the company. This recognition highlights the executive leadership at the helm of the organization as it continues its operations in the commercial lighting and retail display sectors.
